register.labelZh: FORCE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: force back 可以描述某人努力忍住眼淚、笑聲、尖叫或其他強烈情緒。；當某人沒有胃口、不喜歡食物,或覺得某物難以吞嚥時,可以使用 force something down。；force itself on somebody 可以描述某個事實、想法或現實變得非常清楚,令人再也無法忽視。；force something on somebody 表示某人或機構違反對方意願,強迫他們接受某事物。
register.summaryEn: Force back helps you describe somebody trying hard not to cry, laugh, scream or show another strong feeling. Force something down is useful when somebody has no appetite, dislikes the food or finds something difficult to swallow. Force itself on somebody can describe the moment when a fact, idea or difficult reality becomes completely clear. Force something on somebody shows that a person or organisation makes somebody accept something against their wishes.
